member.name: M:bolt.module.tool.verbs.xpp.XppUninstallVerb.ResolveTargetEntry(bolt.cli.Command)
member.summary: Resolve which SDK entry to uninstall. Priority order: 1. Explicit --version X.Y.Z.W always wins (works without an active auth profile). 2. No flag + only one SDK installed → that single SDK is the obvious target. 3. No flag + active auth profile points at an env whose Dataverse URL matches an entry → use it. 4. Otherwise → error with a friendly listing so the user can pick.

member.summary: Installs the X++ SDK using Path A (public UDE via the Power Platform Dev Tools service). The Dev Tools service accepts a Dataverse bearer token, so this path needs only the Dataverse preauth that PAC CLI already has — no F&O resource preauth required.

member.name: M:bolt.module.tool.xpp.XppSdkInstaller.IsValidAppVersionForPath(System.String)
member.summary: Validates that an app-version string is safe to use as a path segment / filename component. Allows letters, digits, '.', and '-'; rejects empty/whitespace, any other char (path separators, control chars, etc.), and the '..' substring that would cause Path.Combine to resolve to a parent directory at the OS level.
